constraints: Only meaningful when called from within an error-handling project method installed via ON ERR CALL; it stops the execution that ON ERR CALL intercepted and resumes control at the appropriate outer level (form, menu, process, or import/export/query operation) instead of showing 4D's standard error dialog.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Stops the interrupted execution from within an installed error-handling method, in place of 4D's standard error dialog box.
